plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Respiratory Therapy map for 2026-2027' and the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. This plan transcribes the program's first/default pathway, 'Respiratory Therapy - CalGETC / Associate of Science / 82-83.5 units / 7 terms / to Degree', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map with no second-institution section. The program page lists one further pathway for the same AS credential, 'Respiratory Therapy, Associate of Science, 76 units, 6 terms, to Degree', which is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 82-83.5 units, and term totals as 10-11.5 / 12 / 6 / 13.5 / 13.5 / 13.5 / 13.5. The only ranged row is Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 82 units. Term 3 is the map's Summer term, encoded here as semester 3 in map order. Twelve major courses (RSPT B1T, B1C, B51L, B2T, B2C, B52L, B3T, B3C, B53L, B4T, B4C, B54L) show a 'Corequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific corequisite courses, so no coreqs are recorded and the flags are disclosed on those course rows. No row shows a 'Prerequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag. The 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' slot is printed in both Terms 2 and 6 and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each occurrence exactly as printed. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
